title: Publish Model Runtime Hints & Pinning Policy Schema
creator: Liam O'Connor
description:
Goal: Define and publish a compact, extensible API schema to expose per-model runtime hints, performance profiles, and version pinning policy. This schema will be consumed by the gateway, Console, SDKs, and Dedicated/Private control planes to make routing, autoscaling, and rollback decisions. It must be backward-compatible with the existing model manifest surface but add structured fields for: performanceProfiles (latency and cost buckets), optimalBatchSize, recommendedQuantizationProfile, contextWindowMax, streamingSupport, functionCallingSupport, stabilityScore, affinityTags, pinningPolicy (pin scope, allowed fallbacks, deprecation window), and telemetry endorsement fields.

Why: current onboarding produces a free-text "notes" blob and scattered manifest flags. That prevents automated fallback routing and prevents Console from suggesting optimal run-time defaults. A structured schema enables: (1) deterministic pinning behavior across Hosted/Dedicated/Private, (2) route cost/latency-aware decisions in the gateway, and (3) automatic Console recommendations for batching, quantization, and cache TTL.

Non-goals: this ticket does not implement gateway routing logic or Console UI. It only defines the API contract, server-side publishing endpoint, validation rules, and the migration strategy for existing manifests.
acceptance_criteria: A JSON schema (Draft 2020-12) for /models/{id}/runtime-hints that validates model capability and performance profiles
Backward-compatible schema versioning: v1 and v2 compatibility rules documented
Server-side validation and a publish endpoint implemented and covered by unit tests
A sample publisher CLI and a one-off migration script to backfill existing models
SDK model/manifest clients updated to surface runtimeHints as typed fields
Design review and API review sign-off from Security and Console owners
migration_plan: Stage 1: Schema draft published in Confluence and API preview enabled on staging for a subset of models (feature-flagged).
Stage 2: Backfill script maps existing manifest notes -> best-effort runtimeHints (optimalBatchSize, contextWindowMax, streamingSupport) and stores them in a new column on models table.
Stage 3: SDKs opt into reading runtimeHints when feature flag enabled; Console shows a ‘preview’ banner for administrators.
Stage 4: Monitor telemetry for 4 weeks (latency, error-rate, routing fallbacks) and iterate on fields that are ambiguous.
Stage 5: Flip feature flag and open a deprecation timeline for the legacy free-text fields (90 days).
rollout_plan: Backfill run: 2026-03-05 -> report generated and reviewed
Staging -> canary (10% of new model publishes): 2026-03-15
Full rollout to Hosted: 2026-03-25 (subject to no critical regressions)
comments: 2026-03-01 - Liam O'Connor: Draft schema posted to Confluence. Added fields for performanceProfiles (p50/p95/throughput), recommendedQuantizationProfile, and pinningPolicy. Requested API review from Gateway and Console owners.

2026-03-02 - Aisha Patel: Implemented initial server-side validation and added unit tests for numeric ranges and required fields. Opened PR #2418. Leaving pinningPolicy semantics intentionally permissive to accommodate org vs project scope.
2026-03-03 - Product (Marta Ruiz): Suggested adding a 'deprecationWindowDays' on pinningPolicy so model maintainers can schedule automatic unpinning. Added to schema draft.
2026-03-04 - Security (Ravi Singh): Requested clarification on which runtimeHints are considered PII or sensitive: affinityTags must be sanitized. Marking security review required.
2026-03-05 - Liam O'Connor: Addressed security feedback; added allowlist + hash_hint for affinityTags, updated PR. Ready for API review (owners: @gateway, @console, @sdk)
